regular.name: Regular Cleaning
regular.description: Standard upkeep for homes and offices. Dusting, mopping, wiping surfaces, sanitizing kitchens and bathrooms.

deep.name: Deep Cleaning (GoFurther)
deep.description: Exhaustive deep clean for homes and businesses. Targets built-up grime, baseboards, grout lines, and behind appliances.
features: Deep tile grout scrubbing & lime scale removal

moveInOut.name: Move-In / Move-Out
moveInOut.description: Complete top-to-bottom reset for incoming or departing tenants and homeowners. Designed for security deposit recovery.
features: Window sills, tracks & interior glass touch-up

postConstruction.name: Post-Construction
postConstruction.description: Maximum depth cleaning with industrial HEPA filtration. Clears drywall dust, fine plaster, tape residue, and paint specks.

about.title: About GoPropertyCare
about.subtitle: Denver's premier property care and residential cleaning specialists.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: At GoPropertyCare, we believe a spotless space fosters clarity, health, and peace of mind. We deliver hospital-grade cleanliness with white-glove hospitality to homes, rental properties, and commercial venues across Denver and Boulder.

values.ecoDesc: We use sustainable, pet-safe, and child-safe cleaning agents that protect your indoor air quality.
values.vettedDesc: Every cleaner is thoroughly vetted, trained in modern techniques, and covered by comprehensive liability insurance.
values.standardDesc: We follow a meticulous checklist to ensure zero missed spots, from ceiling corners to floorboards.
values.pricingDesc: No arbitrary hourly estimates. You pay for the actual size of your space with guaranteed transparent pricing.

checklist.title: Our Comprehensive Cleaning Checklist
checklist.kitchen: Kitchen: Countertops, stovetop, exterior appliances, sinks, faucets sanitized, cabinet fronts wiped.
checklist.bathrooms: Bathrooms: Tile scrubbed, glass polished, toilets & showers disinfected, mirrors shined.
checklist.living: Living & Bedrooms: High/low dusting, mirrors, picture frames, vacuuming under accessible furniture.
checklist.floors: Floors: Thorough vacuuming of carpets and damp-mopping of hard surfaces with pH-neutral solutions.
